reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing attachment extension for DeepSeek Harness Web, designed to expand supported composer attachments and process files into text/image content within the chat flow. Based on the README and package metadata, its main function is document processing (format conversion, OCR, and spill/index-card workflows), with moderate risk from file handling and optional external OCR/doc-parser integrations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，面向用户增强聊天界面附件能力，支持更多文档与图片格式并将其内容按文档卡片方式引入输入流程。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that enhances chat attachment handling by accepting additional document and image formats and injecting processed content into the composer flow as document-style attachment handling.

capabilities: Parsing and converting multiple attachment formats before composing messages
Drag-and-drop/paste-based attachment ingestion in the web UI
Text extraction and OCR processing for scanned PDFs
Long-attachment overflow handling via workspace spill files and index-card workflow
Optional integration with external OCR/document parsing services

reasons.code: README lists support for PDF, Office (docx/xlsx/pptx), text, EPUB/ODT/RTF, TIFF, images, plus long-document index-card handling and merge-on-send behavior.
README documents optional OCR/external integration paths (Baidu OCR env vars, OpenAI-compatible VLM endpoint, external doc-server convert contract), indicating network service usage.
Package manifest exposes plugin host/client entrypoints (lib/index.js and lib/client.js via exports) and declares DSH web client injection settings for runtime integration.
Repository tree includes conversion modules for pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/ocr/image formats and cache/index handling modules, matching the described attachment-processing feature set.

capabilities: Parsing and converting multiple attachment formats before composing messages
